subject: Exercise library: real dedupe/repoint data migration
description: Deferred from docs/shared-exercise-library.md: the SharedExerciseLibrary migration shipped by wiping dev DBs instead of migrating data. Before the schema ever changes against data worth preserving on a device (e.g. once TestFlight builds are out), write the real data migration: dedupe same-named ExerciseDefinitions into one survivor and repoint RoutineExercise/ExerciseSet/ExerciseFeedback FKs. Revisit only when there's real data at stake; related to TestFlight prep (task 39).
